<script>
const phrases = [
  "Data Scientist & Machine Learning Engineer & Website Designer",
  "MS Business Analytics @ UCSD",
  "Machine Learning · NLP · Cloud Computing",
  "Turning data into decisions that matter ✨"
];
let i = 0, j = 0, deleting = false;
const el = document.getElementById("typewriter");
function type() {
  if (!el) return;
  const current = phrases[i];
  if (!deleting) {
    el.textContent = current.slice(0, ++j);
    if (j === current.length) { deleting = true; setTimeout(type, 1800); return; }
  } else {
    el.textContent = current.slice(0, --j);
    if (j === 0) { deleting = false; i = (i + 1) % phrases.length; }
  }
  setTimeout(type, deleting ? 40 : 70);
}
type();
</script>
